spans.s: tṛṇa, cf. a-tṛṇa-kāṣṭha-grahaṇa (IE 8-5); grass which the villagers were obliged to supply to the king or landlord on occasions or to the touring officers.
tṛṇ-odaka (IE 8-5; EI 12, 28), name of a tax or cess; the grazing tax.
tṛṇa-kāṣṭh-odak-opeta (EI 23), ‘together with grass and fuel and the waters’.
tṛṇa-pūti(or yūti)-gocara-paryanta (EI 12), epithet of gift land; see sva-sīmā-tṛṇa-yūti (or pūti)-gocara-paryanta, etc.
